162: Forces - him to give her a bill of divorce.

No [ruling of] "forces" is relevant here, etc. - she doesn't require a bill of divorce from him, since the mishna teaches that she is permitted to relatives. If a bill of divorce was required, she would have been rendered forbidden to his brothers as the divorcee of a brother.
Rather, to the latter clause - in which she says "you betrothed me" and requires a bill of divorce.
